title: Clarify NPC intent early: the notice board hints at two paths, but the game strongly guides toward verses (priest opens doors for free, elder won't talk about crown until after barrow). Make the crown path equally viable or acknowledge it as the 'harder' route

evidence.quote: Clarify NPC intent early: the notice board hints at two paths, but the game strongly guides toward verses (priest opens doors for free, elder won't talk about crown until after barrow). Make the crown path equally viable or acknowledge it as the 'harder' route

The reeve asks you to promise to seal the barrow, but both the verses and crown paths automatically leave it open. There's no way to actually seal it - the seal/open choice mentioned at the start doesn't seem to exist.
Consider one explicit choice before speaking verses: 'seal the barrow afterward' vs 'leave it open for the dead' to match reeve/priest conflict
Not explicitly clear that the verses path leaves the barrow open while the crown path might seal it—only learned this at the ending
A brief recap of the two endings (verses→open, crown→sealed) on the notice board would help players make informed path choices
